projects.title: HCL Unica – Cloud-Native Deployment on Google Cloud
projects.description: Delivered the cloud-native deployment of the HCL Unica marketing platform on Google Kubernetes Engine, moving the product from a traditional on-premises install to a containerised, cluster-based architecture.
responsibilities: Moved the platform from an on-premises install to a containerised deployment on GKE Maintained Helm charts in GitHub and Docker images in a Harbor private registry
Drove automated, repeatable deployments across environments with GitLab CI/CD and Argo CD
Handled environment configuration and release management across development, testing and production

projects.title: Banking Website Migration to Adobe Edge Delivery Services
projects.description: Migrated a banking client's website estate from on-premises hosting to Adobe Edge Delivery Services, covering build, content deployment and environment configuration across staging and production.
responsibilities: Built the delivery pipeline in Azure DevOps with source hosted in Azure Repos Automated build, content deployment and environment configuration across staging and production
Replaced manual release steps and removed handoffs between the infrastructure and web teams

projects.title: HCL Discover – Cloud-Native Deployment on Azure
projects.description: Deployed and operated HCL Discover, a digital experience analytics and session-replay platform, on Azure Kubernetes Service across a cluster running both Windows and Linux node pools.
responsibilities: Ran the platform on a mixed Windows and Linux node pool cluster, handling OS-specific scheduling, node affinity and cross-platform networking on shared infrastructure

Packaged the application as Helm charts, version-controlled in GitHub Built and published Docker images to a Harbor private registry Automated release through Jenkins for CI and Argo CD for GitOps-based continuous deployment

projects.title: Cloud-Native DevOps Automation Platform
projects.description: OpsAction is a cloud-native DevOps automation platform designed to simplify infrastructure provisioning, Kubernetes deployments, CI/CD management, and operational monitoring. It provides a centralized interface to manage multi-cloud environments, automate deployments, and streamline DevOps workflows for enterprise applications.
responsibilities: Designed and developed the OpsAction platform architecture
Implemented automated infrastructure provisioning using Terraform
Integrated CI/CD pipelines for containerized applications
Managed Kubernetes deployments (k3s, EKS, GKE)
Configured monitoring and logging using Prometheus and Grafana
Implemented secure SSH access and tunneling features
Optimized deployment workflows for cost and performance
Maintained multi-cloud compatibility (AWS, GCP)

projects.title: ThingWorx IoT Platform – Operations & Monitoring
projects.description: Production ThingWorx IoT platform operated across GCP and AWS, provisioned with Terraform and configured with Ansible, with responsibility for availability and release automation.
responsibilities: Operated the platform across both clouds with responsibility for availability and release automation
Ran centralised monitoring and alerting with Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch and GCP Cloud Monitoring
Owned the support ticket queue end to end, from incident triage through to resolution with internal teams and cloud vendor support

projects.title: Home Lab – k3s on Proxmox
projects.description: Self-managed Kubernetes cluster running on Proxmox at home, used for testing deployments, pipelines and monitoring setups outside client work.
responsibilities: Built and maintain a k3s cluster on Proxmox virtual machines, handling networking, ingress and persistent storage
Package and deploy applications to the cluster with Helm charts
Run self-hosted services in Docker with persistent volumes, backup and recovery procedures
Use the cluster to test upgrades, pipeline changes and monitoring configurations before applying them elsewhere
